Laguna de Bay.municipality: Multiple lakeshore municipalities in Laguna; also Rizal and Metro Manila

tilapia.habitat_requirements: Warm freshwater shallows with food and sheltered spawning areas. Temperature, oxygen and water chemistry must be checked locally.
tilapia.fit: a warm, sheltered margin rather than a cold torrent
tilapia.limitations: Introduced species; historical farming does not establish a wild population or present suitability.

image.alt: Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus); reference photograph, not a local observation
image.author: Bob Walker
image.changes: Resized, with the full photograph fitted inside a square frame; no claim of local occurrence.

hito.habitat_requirements: Freshwater margins, ponds and wetland-like refuges with cover and accessible surface air. Air breathing does not make polluted water safe.
hito.fit: a quiet covered margin with surface access
hito.limitations: This is C. macrocephalus, not African catfish or a hybrid. Local presence and available vegetated refuge are unverified.

image.alt: Broadhead catfish (Clarias macrocephalus); reference photograph, not a local observation
image.author: Judgefloro
image.changes: Resized, with the full photograph fitted inside a square frame; no claim of local occurrence.

dalag.habitat_requirements: Freshwater pools and wetland margins with cover, suitable prey and surface access; exposed high-velocity water is a poor default assumption.
dalag.fit: a slower pool or vegetated refuge with prey
dalag.limitations: Predatory feeding and air breathing do not prove survival under the actual local chemistry or pollution conditions.

carp.habitat_requirements: Lake or reservoir shallows and slower river reaches with bottom food and suitable spawning substrate; fast cascades are excluded.
carp.fit: a slower shallow feeding area with suitable bottom substrate
carp.limitations: Introduced species. Depth, food, substrate and seasonal conditions remain unmeasured; this is not a stocking recommendation.

ayungin.habitat_requirements: Freshwater lake habitat with food, adequate oxygen and suitable breeding/refuge areas; local life-stage requirements must be checked.
ayungin.fit: a freshwater lake margin with sufficient food and oxygen
ayungin.limitations: An endemic Philippine species is not automatically present in every Philippine lake; local establishment is unconfirmed.

kanduli.habitat_requirements: Freshwater lake feeding habitat and suitable reproductive conditions; the common family name sea catfish does not mean saltwater is obligatory here.
kanduli.limitations: Selected only for Laguna de Bay. The cited historical species research does not verify current presence or current water quality.

goby.habitat_requirements: Freshwater or low-salinity benthic habitat with appropriate substrate, food and flow refuges; habitat varies along stream gradients.
goby.fit: a connected pool or sheltered bottom habitat with appropriate substrate
goby.limitations: Biya covers several species. This candidate refers only to G. giuris; migration access, substrate and actual identity need field checks.

loach.habitat_requirements: Flowing freshwater stream habitat with hard-bottom refuges. Verify substrate, oxygen, flow and passage before treating any waterfall reach as suitable.
loach.fit: an accessible flowing stream reach with rock refuges
loach.limitations: Only conditional connected-stream habitat is assessed, never the falling water itself or an assumed population above a barrier.

bangus.habitat_requirements: Juveniles can use freshwater grow-out habitat, but marine spawning and early life stages require a different setting and salinity regime.
bangus.fit: freshwater juvenile grow-out habitat in a large lake
bangus.limitations: Selected only for Laguna de Bay. Adult survival and a self-sustaining freshwater breeding population are not equivalent; no stocking or production recommendation.

Bunot Lake.habitat_explanation: Assess sheltered lake margins only; shoreline cover and oxygen below the surface remain unmeasured.
Bunot Lake.limitations: No current local salinity, temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, substrate, prey or connectivity survey has been validated. These are conditional educational estimates, not occurrence records, survival guarantees or stocking advice.

Laguna de Bay.limitations: No current local salinity, temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, substrate, prey or connectivity survey has been validated. These are conditional educational estimates, not occurrence records, survival guarantees or stocking advice.
